prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic high-fashion waist-up portrait of one original approved adult man against a deep burgundy gradient studio background.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult man with olive skin, lean athletic build, sharp oval face, deep-set eyes, thick brows, light stubble, slicked-back jet-black hair, and a composed direct gaze. He wears a tailored charcoal-gray three-piece pinstripe suit, white spread-collar shirt, burgundy tie with gold tie bar, white pocket square, supplied metal watch and ring; one hand is in a trouser pocket and the other holds a toothpick near his lips. Preserve supplied neck and finger tattoos as reference details.
composition_elements: Centered waist-up eye-level portrait on an 85mm lens.
Relaxed dominant posture with hand placement, toothpick, suit layers, tie bar, watch and pocket square clearly visible.
Deep burgundy matte gradient background with no text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft frontal key light with subtle fill and gentle rim light, warm cinematic grading, controlled suit highlights, and refined editorial contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, realistic pores, stubble, wool pinstripe and metal texture, subtle analog grain, no text or watermark.
